utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, see you then at 6:30. I’ll bring the drill and a few extra tools just in case.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, 6:30 works for me. I’ll be there and can help with whatever you need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, thanks Eli—see you at 6:30.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive, now that it’s Sunday at the community center, and see who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can bring my hammer and screwdriver, and I’ll look for the wrench set before Sunday at the community center. What else do you need?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’s great, Dane — if you can also bring any extra nails and tape, that’d really help. I’ll keep spreading the word to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll send the volunteer names as soon as I have them. See you after 3 on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thanks Uli—see you after 3 on Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Will do, Rosa. I’ll send the volunteer names over as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell—that’d be a big help. I’ll check what we’re still short on and let you know before Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good—just let me know what’s still needed, and I can help spread the word or pitch in where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll take another look at the supplies and make a list of anything we’re missing. Then I’ll send you the updates before Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, that’s right — Sunday at the community center. I’m still collecting any extra tools or supplies, so if you hear of anything, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll pass along anything useful I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Leo — I appreciate it. I’ll keep gathering anything people can spare for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m sending the repair drive details and school times next, and I’ll include a rain backup too. Let’s pin down the dates soon so everyone can plan.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — do we have a date yet, or are we still pinning that down?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re still pinning it down, but I’ll send the proposed date and rain backup as soon as I have them. Want me to loop you in the minute it’s set?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure—send me the repair drive details and the school times, and I’ll help work around them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye. I’ll send the repair drive details over and keep you posted on the school times if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—once you send the repair drive details, I’ll help fit it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’s right — Opal’s still leading it. If anyone needs tools, I’ll point them your way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Noah — that helps a lot. If anyone asks, tell them I’m keeping track of the locations and I’ll share the details as soon as they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll send them your way and let them know you’ve got the locations covered.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, it’s still on this Saturday morning at the community center. I’m glad you can help spread the word about tools and supplies, too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — Saturday morning at the community center, got it. I’ll let people know we still need basic tools and supplies like screws, nails, tarps, and duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — thanks, Hana. I’ll keep an ear out for anyone who can bring extras and pass it along while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — send the names when you can, and I’ll keep an eye out for anything else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do, Mara — I’ll send the names over today and let you know if I can grab anything else for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out for the names and let you know if anything else comes up for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, it’s still happening — I’m just locking in the exact time now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo — I’ll be ready and keep an eye out for your update.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I’ll send the exact time as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. Do you still need any tools or extra hands?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m mostly set, but I’m still waiting on the exact address before I can lock in the timing. If you have the wrench set, that’d help too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll check for the wrench set and get back to you with the address if I can find it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details, but I’m glad it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries — I’ll send you the repair drive details and school times next.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — send them over when you can, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks—please send the repair drive details and school times when you can. I’m just trying to make sure the timing and tools are sorted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll send over the repair drive details and school times so you can sort the timing and tools. If anything else needs pinning down, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal — that helps. Once you send the details, I’ll check the timing and see if we’re still short on any tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I can spread the word and mention basic repair tools. If there’s anything else you still need, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — that would be a big help. If you can also mention we could use a few more volunteers, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I’ll pass along that you still need a few more volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can use extra hands, and a few basic tools would help too. Thanks for being willing to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with the hands part. Let me know what time you need me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Rey — I really appreciate it. I’ll send you the time as soon as I’ve got it nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, it’s still happening on Sunday at the community center. I’m checking our supplies now and will let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I can help with whatever’s left—just let me know what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mara — I’ll check what’s missing and get back to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — that sounds right. This Saturday morning at the community center, with small home repairs like leaky faucets, loose cabinets, and broken shelves.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll send the repair drive details and school times now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks, Leo. If you send the details, I’ll double-check them and share them along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — that’d really help. We still need a few more hands for the small repairs, so spreading the word would be great.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word, and I’ll mention it’s now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and appreciate you getting the word out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, Ira—sounds like the repair drive’s really coming together. If anyone else has tools or supplies to spare, send them my way and I’ll pass it on.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess — that’d be a huge help. I’ll keep gathering tools and supplies this week and send any extras your way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Ira — I’ll keep an ear out and let folks know. Thanks for gathering everything; it’s really helping pull the repair drive together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what time are we meeting, and is there anything you still need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yep, it’s still on this Saturday morning at the community center. Just confirming before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. What time Saturday morning should I be at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can also swing by early and lend a hand if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Do we have a date for the repair drive yet, or are we still figuring that out?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re still figuring it out, but I can keep my morning open once we lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again — I’ve got my hammer and screwdriver, and I’ll check for the wrench set before I head over Sunday to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Dane — Sunday at the community center works, and I’ll send the school times along so we can coordinate. If you can check for the wrench set, that would be great.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll look for the wrench set and head to the community center Sunday. Thanks for sending the school times; I’ll coordinate when I’m on my way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: After 3 works for me too—thanks, Uli. And yes, please send the volunteers’ names when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — I’ll send them over as soon as I can. And yes, a couple of extra hands would really help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, happy to help where I can. Just send me the list when you’ve got it.
